changelog.entry: Every chapter is open from the start. Pick any of the 60 shifts in any order; nothing is locked behind earlier shifts any more. A Rough seal still counts as a finished shift toward every total, goal and achievement, and older saves load with everything open.

Station Medic opens its doors: sixty shifts in eight chapters, from quiet signs-only evenings to the long night before the tender docks. Crew come into the infirmary with signs, you choose the scans and the treatments from a thin supply cabinet, and every shift can be finished with no cost whatever the scans say. Look-alike conditions need scans, charts forbid some cures, supplies are shared, spore flecks need the cold room, shaking patients need steadying (with help from Tally, the second medic robot), and some patients carry two conditions at once. Crew stories and a Record of every condition and treatment fill in as you play. A bad call only lowers the shift's seal, and you can always restore the shift. Every condition and treatment is invented.
